card.name: Final letters of units before a closing bracket
card.fires_on: The last letter or piece of a unit or short word, such as mL, mcg/mL, a.m., tsp or eGFR, often just before a closing parenthesis or a cross-reference like (see ...).

modes.label: Unit endings
modes.description: The last letter of a measure such as mL or mcg/mL after a slash or number.
modes.example: metformin plasma levels generally greater than 5 mcg/m<< L>>. ( 5.2 ) •

modes.label: Start of see-reference in brackets
modes.description: The letter s of "see" opening a cross-reference in brackets.
modes.example: LILETTA does not protect against HIV/STI transmission [<< s>> ee Warnings and Precautions (

modes.label: Abbreviation pieces
modes.description: A piece inside a short abbreviation or split word such as eGFR or a.m.
modes.example: estimated glomerular filtration rate (e<< G>>FR) below

card.writes: It favors line-ending closing punctuation such as a closing parenthesis, bracket or quote followed by a line break.
card.plain: It marks the end of a unit or abbreviation where a closing bracket or cross-reference is likely to come next.
